landing.title: National Legal Metrology Digital Verification Portal
landing.subtitle: Unified statutory compliance platform for weights, measures, weighing and measuring instruments under the Legal Metrology Act, 2009
landing.traderDesc: Register weighing instruments, submit statutory verification/re-verification applications, and download digital certificates.
landing.verifierDesc: Conduct on-site inspections with GeoVisit GPS geofencing, record measurement readings, and submit verification reports.
landing.authorityDesc: Review applications, assign verification officers/GATCs, audit compliance, and digitally issue Form 6 verification certificates.
landing.publicVerifyDesc: Scan QR code or enter certificate number to instantly verify authenticity against the national digital registry.
landing.quickAccessSubtitle: 1-Click Direct Demo Authentication into each RBAC role:
landing.heroBadge: Statutory Online Portal under Section 24 of Legal Metrology Act, 2009
landing.heroTitle: Online Verification & Lifecycle Certification for Weighing and Measuring Instruments
landing.heroSubtitle: A single-window digital interface for commercial establishments, traders, manufacturers, and repairers to register instruments, apply for statutory verification / re-verification, track application lifecycle stages, and obtain verifiable digital certificates.
landing.servicesSubtitle: Choose your service category to initiate verification, check compliance status, or access officer tools.
landing.card1Desc: Submit online applications for initial stamping (Original Verification) or statutory periodic Re-verification. Supports both Camp / Centre and In-situ testing modes.
landing.card2Desc: Track the statutory processing stage of your submitted application using the reference number. Monitor review, inspector assignment, scheduled dates, and results.
landing.card3Desc: Verify the validity of statutory verification certificates issued under the Act. Consumers and enforcement authorities can authenticate instrument credentials instantly.
landing.card4Desc: Role-based workspace for Legal Metrology Officers (LMO) and Approved Test Centres (GATC). Record test points, nominal readings matrix, evidence, and issue certificates.
landing.processTitle: How the Statutory Verification Process Works
landing.step1Desc: Trader/owner logs into the secure digital portal.
landing.step2Desc: Choose device or register new instrument specifications.
landing.step3Desc: Select Original or Re-verification, Camp or In-situ testing.
landing.step4Desc: Review details, attach documents, and obtain Reference No.
landing.step5Desc: Authorized LMO/GATC conducts physical testing and records readings.
landing.step6Desc: Download official digital certificate and QR compliance seal.
